sentences.imageNotes: 晚上，主角小女孩和家人一起走在熱鬧的夜市入口附近，大家看起來期待又開心。背景可以有攤位、燈光、食物和行人，但所有招牌、旗子、攤位牌都不能有可讀文字或數字，也不要品牌標誌。
sentences.imagePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: L342 sentence image, square 1:1 lesson illustration. Illustrate 今晚我們要去夜市。 Show the recurring protagonist girl walking with her family near a lively Taiwan night market entrance in the evening. Use the approved L058 lesson images only as style references: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed but clean environments, expressive preschool proportions, bright warm palette, and phone-readable square composition. Use the recurring protagonist girl identity: preschool-age girl with short dark bob, small pink hair clip, pink cardigan or soft pink child clothing, navy skirt, pink shoes, and yellow bag when natural. Family members must be warm and visually distinct from teacher identities. Show food stalls, lights, blank colored stall boards, and passersby without any readable marks. No readable text, Chinese characters, letters, numbers, zhuyin, subtitles, labels, brands, logos, license plates, route signs, store signs, or watermarks.

sentences.text: 學生們全都到齊，才能開車。
sentences.spokenText: 學生們全都到齊才能開車
sentences.imageNotes: 校外教學出發前，學校門口停著一台遊覽車或大巴。學生們在老師帶領下集合，老師正在確認大家都到齊，車子還停著準備出發。畫面要呈現「學生們到齊後才能開車」，不要車牌、路線牌、文字、數字、品牌或危險交通畫面。
sentences.imagePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: L342 sentence image, square 1:1 lesson illustration. Illustrate 學生們全都到齊，才能開車。 Show a school field trip departure scene outside a warm Taiwan school entrance. A large tour bus is parked safely and not moving while a recurring teacher checks that the preschool students are all present. Use L058 only as style reference: fine pencil-and-watercolor linework, warm natural light, bright warm palette, detailed but clean environment, expressive preschool proportions, soft natural faces, phone-readable square composition. Use a teacher identity visually distinct from the protagonist mother: tidy school clothing, calm professional posture, holding a blank clipboard or blank paper. Generic classmates may appear but must not look like named 小月 or 小光. No readable text, Chinese characters, letters, numbers, zhuyin, subtitles, labels, brands, logos, license plates, route signs, school sign text, bus destination text, or watermarks. Clipboard, papers, bus plates, and sign panels must be blank.

sentences.imageNotes: 一間乾淨明亮的小店裡，貨架上整齊擺著很多不同種類的生活用品、文具或玩具，小女孩和媽媽在店裡看東西。畫面要呈現「店裡東西很多、種類齊全」，不要價格牌、商品文字、品牌、標籤或可讀文字。
sentences.imagePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: L342 sentence image, square 1:1 lesson illustration. Illustrate 這間店的東西很齊全。 Show a clean bright neighborhood shop with shelves neatly stocked with many different kinds of household goods, stationery, simple toys, baskets, cups, notebooks, balls, boxes, and other non-branded items. Use L058 only as style reference: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, natural light, bright palette, clean detailed environment, expressive preschool proportions, phone-readable square composition. Use the recurring protagonist girl identity and recurring protagonist mother identity; the mother must be a warm family adult, visually distinct from teacher, shop owner, and generic adults. No readable text, Chinese characters, letters, numbers, zhuyin, price tags, product labels, brand marks, logos, store sign text, shelf labels, or watermarks. All packages, notebooks, boxes, and labels must be blank or abstract non-readable shapes.

sentences.text: 孩子們先整理書包，再出門。
sentences.spokenText: 孩子們先整理書包再出門
sentences.imageNotes: 家門口玄關，主角爸爸看著兩個固定角色孩子已經把書包整理好了，接著要準備出門。兩個孩子請使用固定角色，不要畫成 generic children；建議使用主角小女孩和她固定妹妹的既有外觀 continuity，兩人背著或拿著整理好的書包，鞋子也準備好。畫面要清楚呈現「先整理書包，再出門」，爸爸表情溫和，不要品牌、姓名牌、文字或數字。
sentences.imagePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: L342 sentence image, square 1:1 lesson illustration. Illustrate 孩子們先整理書包，再出門。 Show a warm Taiwan home entryway where the recurring protagonist father watches gently as two fixed child identities finish organizing their school bags and get ready to go out. Use L058 only as style reference: fine pencil-and-watercolor linework, warm natural morning light, bright palette, detailed clean home, expressive preschool proportions, phone-readable square composition. The two children must be the recurring protagonist girl and her fixed younger sister, not generic children. Protagonist girl: short dark bob, pink hair clip, pink cardigan or soft pink clothing, navy skirt, pink shoes, yellow organized school bag. Younger sister: smaller preschool child, twin pigtails, warm expression, matching yellow and coral-red family palette, visibly younger and shorter, with her own small organized bag. Father: recurring protagonist father identity, steady adult family role, simple warm home clothing, visually distinct from teacher and mother. Show organized backpacks, shoes ready, and open doorway. No readable text, Chinese characters, letters, numbers, zhuyin, name tags, labels, brands, logos, UI symbols, or watermarks.

sentences.imageNotes: 學校辦公室或教室角落，幾位老師坐在桌旁開會，桌上有空白紙張、杯子或資料夾，但沒有可讀文字。老師們表情專注、溫和，場景清楚是老師們在一起開會，不要畫成家長會，也不要讓老師看起來像主角媽媽。
sentences.imagePrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: L342 sentence image, square 1:1 lesson illustration. Illustrate 老師們今天要開會。 Show five adult teachers sitting around a meeting table in a quiet Taiwan school office or classroom corner. Use L058 only as style reference: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, clean detailed school environment, bright warm palette, soft natural faces, phone-readable square composition. Teachers must be clearly school staff, not parents: varied adult faces, tidy muted blue, green, gray, and beige school-office clothing, professional listening and discussion posture, visually distinct from the protagonist mother. Include an older male teacher with glasses, a younger male teacher, and several female teachers with hairstyles and clothing different from the protagonist mother. Avoid the protagonist mother's soft yellow/coral family palette. Table has blank papers, plain folders, cups, and pencils. No readable text, Chinese characters, letters, numbers, zhuyin, captions, labels, name tags, meeting notes, calendar writing, brands, logos, UI symbols, or watermarks. Wall posters, papers, folders, book spines, labels, and screens must be blank or abstract non-readable shapes.
